items.item: The page has breadcrumbs back to the suppliers list, and the header shows the supplier name untruncated, a supplier code, a status lozenge with a text label, and up to four key fields
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] Purchasing / Suppliers / name; h1 'Công ty TNHH Thép Việt Phát' (full, no truncate); 'SUP-0142' + badge 'Active'; 4-field dl: Category, Payment terms, Buyer, Spend last 12 months.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Create purchase order") with other actions such as edit or deactivate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: The single primary button in the header is 'Edit supplier' (B_PRIMARY); the overflow '...' holds Export and Deactivate. Edit is therefore the primary action rather than a secondary one, and 'New purchase order' exists only inside the Purchase orders tab, not in the header.

items.item: Sections (overview, contacts, purchase orders, documents, performance) are reachable through tabs or an anchor bar, with the first section loaded by default and the active one marked for assistive technology
items.evidence: #tabs role=tablist with role=tab buttons, aria-selected, roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End keys; panel role=tabpanel aria-labelledby; S.tab defaults to 'overview' and ensureLoaded loads it.

items.item: Company details are shown as label–value pairs in a read-only layout, with empty values handled consistently and never shown as "N/A", and email and phone shown as links with the primary contact marked
items.evidence: Overview uses read-only dl pairs and empty values render '—' (dl helper: v || '—'), and the primary contact is marked (badge 'Primary'). But Main email, Main phone and the contacts-table email/phone are plain text (esc(s.email), esc(c.email)); there are no mailto:/tel: links.

items.item: The purchase orders list shows PO number, absolute date, status and a right-aligned total with currency, uses tabular figures, and links each PO number to its record
items.evidence: Columns PO number, Status, Order date (dd/mm/yyyy, tabular-nums), Amount (VND) right-aligned with NUM='text-right tabular-nums' (currency only in header). The PO number is a <button data-act='po-open'> that opens a summary dialog, not a link to the PO record.

items.item: Each certificate or document shows its expiry date and a status that combines colour with a text label ("Valid", "Expiring in 30 days", "Expired"), and expired or expiring items are visually surfaced first
items.evidence: Certificates show Expires date plus badge text Valid / Expiring soon / Expired with '(in N days)' or '(N days ago)' beside the date, so status is colour+text. But certRows = S.certs.map(...) keeps data order (ISO 9001 valid first, expired MTC fourth); nothing sorts expired/expiring first. The Overview 'Needs attention' card only links to the tab. Plain documents have no expiry.

items.item: Performance metrics (such as on-time delivery rate and quality or defect rate) state their measurement period and unit, and show a signed change against the previous period without relying on colour alone
items.evidence: Tiles 'On-time delivery, last 3 months' 'xx,x%' with '+1,2 pts vs previous 3 months'; quality, lead time (days) and spend (+x% vs previous 12 months) likewise; signed() adds '+', text explains comparison; table headers carry units (%, days, VND).

items.item: Each section has its own empty state with a useful next action (for example "Add contact", "Upload certificate") and a loading skeleton; a failed section shows an inline error with retry
items.evidence: skeleton(t) per tab with animate-pulse rows; errorBox() 'Couldn't load ...' with Retry button (documents tab fails once to demonstrate); emptyBox for contacts 'Add contact', POs 'New purchase order', certificates 'Add certificate', documents 'Upload document'. Overview, performance and activity have no empty state (minor gap).

items.item: Deactivating the supplier or deleting a document asks for confirmation naming the supplier or file and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: Deactivate: title 'Deactivate ${legalName}?', body states open POs and total stay open, no new orders until reactivated, ok 'Deactivate supplier'; Delete document: title 'Delete document ${name}?', body file size/uploader, ok 'Delete document'. confirmDlg puts autofocus on the Cancel/'Keep ...' button (data-act=dlg-cancel), not the danger button.

notes: Audit score 100 and no template tells observed: flat white/slate surface, no gradients/glass/emoji/uppercase tracking, no greeting header, radii 4-6px, pill deltas always carry a period. Contact initials avatars are used for real people only. Failures are functional: Edit is primary instead of a purchasing action, no mailto/tel links, PO number opens a dialog rather than linking to a record, certificates not sorted with expired/expiring first.
